# Psalm 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. A psalm of David. Only fools say in their hearts, 'There is no God.' They are corrupt; their actions are evil. Not one of them does good.

**2** The LORD looks down from heaven on the entire human race to see if anyone is truly wise, if anyone seeks God.

**3** But no — everyone has turned away. All are corrupt. No one does good — not a single one!

**4** Will these evildoers never learn? They devour my people the way they devour bread. They refuse to pray to the LORD.

**5** But then terror strikes them, because God stands with those who are right.

**6** The wicked frustrate the plans of the oppressed, but the LORD is their refuge.

**7** Who will come from Zion to rescue Israel? When the LORD restores His people, Jacob will shout with joy and Israel will rejoice!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **14:1**: The 'fool' doesn't deny God's existence philosophically — he lives as if God doesn't matter. This is practical atheism, not theoretical.

— PNEUMA
